name: Field_TestAreaOverlapA
signature: u32 Field_TestAreaOverlapA(void* owner, void* point, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, float* offset)
summary: Builds a four-corner box from the point's +0x4C..+0x58 fields plus the caller's offset and tests it against field objects; called by Field_Marker_TestOverlap and Field_Placement_TestAreaA/B.
evidence: Three named callers are field marker/placement overlap tests; body builds corner array and calls Gfx_Scene_QueryRect and Object_IsHandleAlive; 0x006F56F4 is a no-op constructor, so the test runs here.

name: Field_TestAreaOverlapB
signature: u32 Field_TestAreaOverlapB(void* owner, void* point, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, float* offset)
summary: Sibling of 0x00652F48: builds the same four-corner box from the point plus offset and tests it against field objects; only the argument positions differ.
evidence: Same body shape as 0x00652F48 with the same no-op element constructor and same callee set; only caller is maybe_Field_Marker_UpdateScreenOffset.

name: maybe_StaticInit_Array20x8_7ECDA8
summary: Global static initialiser constructing a 20-entry 8-byte table at 0x007ECDA8; the readable body is empty and the disassembly loses ARM/Thumb sync, so the record type is unknown.
evidence: No callers or callees; body shows only std_ConstructArray; header notes ARM/Thumb sync loss at the entry point.

name: maybe_Os_InitExclusiveAccessTable
summary: Early-boot initialiser filling a capability/count block, clearing flags, taking exclusive-access words with LDREX/STREX and filling them with 0xFFFFFFFF, then constructing eight 0x18-byte entries.
evidence: Body shows LDREX/STREX loops writing 0xFFFFFFFF and std_ConstructArray of 8 entries; element constructor 0x0051CBCC lies in the nn::err block, so the entry type is uncertain.

name: maybe_Data_InitPairRecords
summary: Stores the id twice and -1 at self+0/+4/+8, then constructs two 0x20-byte records in the global buffer 0x007EF0F4 with a zeroing constructor and registers an empty destructor stub.
evidence: Disassembly confirms self[0]=self[1]=id, self[2]=-1 and std_ConstructArray(0x007EF0F4,0x00509B1C,0x20,2); 0x007EF0F4 is Gfx-owned but the record type is unknown.

name: maybe_Os_InitListRegistry
summary: Initialises the ordered-list registry: constructs its element array, clears the monitor word at 0x007E793C, initialises that critical section and registers an empty static destructor.
evidence: Disassembly shows str to 0x007E793C then Os_InitCriticalSection(0x007E793C), the same monitor used by the ordered-list insert helper, then a tail call to an empty stub.

name: maybe_StaticInit_Array32x16_7E7BE0
summary: Global static initialiser constructing 0x20 elements of 0x10 bytes at 0x007E7BE0 with a zeroing constructor and re-pointing the table base; the readable body is empty due to ARM/Thumb sync loss.
evidence: No caller; body shows only std_ConstructArray(&g_fsMountTable,0x005052A4,0x10,0x20); 0x007E7BE0 is also referenced by Fs mount/unmount helpers, hinting at a mount table but the element type is unknown.

name: maybe_StaticInit_7AF0AC
summary: Global static initialiser constructing an element array, writing 0 and a 1 flag byte at 0x007AF0AC and two zero words at 0x007AF0B4, and registering an empty static destructor.
evidence: Disassembly shows std_ConstructArray then stores to 0x007AF0AC/0x007AF0B4 and a tail call to an empty stub; the only caller (Ui_SakusenWindow_PushCommandForCursor) does not fit a static initialiser, so the subsystem is unknown.

name: Sound_SeqPlayer_InitTables
summary: Static initialiser of the sequence-player tables: constructs the element array, clears state words at +0x38..+0x44, writes table-base pointers into globals 0x007E7518/0x007AE8BC/0x00781998, then tail-calls Sound_SeqPlayer_InitVoiceMap.
evidence: Tail-call to named Sound_SeqPlayer_InitVoiceMap and fills the sequence-player table globals; std_ConstructArray call matches the documented array construction.
